thread:
maria: Heads-up  need a quick sync on marketplace GTM for CloudScale. proposed public launch May 11, embargo Apr 29. need press + blog + localized microcopy (EN/FR/DE/JA), landing, plus SI demo slots. can we commit? :calendar:

tom: product ok with May 11 but we need the final feature matrix by Apr 23. can marketing land copy that week?

lina: marketing here. can draft the announcement and landing by Apr 20 if we have final logos and the partner quote. localization will need an extra 3 business days per language.

vishal: eng: listing flow and SKU wiring mostly done. blocker: CloudScale test tenant access and a small auth change for the listing webhook. need both by Apr 22 to QA.

sofia: SI/rev ops: demo scheduling  recommend 3 x 1hr blocks on launch week (Americas, EMEA, APAC). will coordinate with partners for availability. also will prep a "how to buy" play for sales.

partner-bot: CloudScale PM @cloudscale-anna DM: "We can do Apr 29 embargo. we'll deliver logo bundle + SKU by Apr 21. partner quote pending internal signoff."

maria: great. timeline sketch:
- Apr 18: creative brief + PR angle to partners
- Apr 20: marketing posts first draft (internal review)
- Apr 21: logos + SKU from CloudScale in repo
- Apr 22: eng QA + test tenant
- Apr 23: product freeze feature list
- Apr 25: localization complete for EN/FR/DE/JA
- Apr 29: embargo lift (partner outreach window)
- May 11: public announcement + demos

tom: pls add rollout roles to timeline (PR, monitoring, demo hosts, escalation).

lina: assigning: PR outreach -> lina + agency, demo hosts -> sofia + vishal, launch monitoring -> tom, partner ops -> maria, legal -> legal. I'll add to the calendar.

legal: need to see partner quote and trademark usage before we go live. legal can review co-marketing copy within 48 hrs of receipt. please tag us early.

vishal: tech checklist (confirm by EOD Apr 22): SKU present, webhook auth fixed, test tenant, automated install (terraform) sample, telemetry UTM tags present, demo image ready.

sofia: demo scripts: "one-click deploy" and "SI customization". will post scripts by Apr 24.

lina: measurement plan: UTM params -> utm_source=cloud-marketplace, utm_medium=listing, utm_campaign=cloudscale-may11. marketing analytics to monitor landing -> signup funnel and listing conversion.

maria: launch day runbook notes: monitoring channel #marketplace-launch, oncall: eng-sre + marketplace eng first 6 hrs; incident owner: tom; press liaison: lina. keep response templates ready.

partner-bot: calendar event "Marketplace GTM Dry Run" Apr 27 09:30-11:00 PT created with partners and core team.

maria: please RSVP. action items recap: lina - blog + press draft, maria - partner comms, vishal - finalize webhook + QA, sofia - demo scripts + schedule, tom - runbook + monitoring. deadline Apr 21/22 for most assets.

cloudscale-anna: confirming partner legal will try to sign off quote by Apr 20. we'll aim to deliver logos early next week.

maria: awesome. if any slippage after Apr 22 we escalate to execs. thanks everyone. :rocket:
